title: app-05: Workspace drag-to-reorder
summary: Drag-to-reorder delle workspace con DnD e action di riordino.
description:
app-05: Workspace drag-to-reorder.

── Findings (verified in code 2026-10-19) ──
OPEN — none of the 4 tasks done. No MoveWorkspace WmAction, no workspace reorder handler, no draggable workspace rows (handlers/workspace.rs has delete/collapse/expand only). Dock/container reorder DOES exist (chrome.container.move_before/after), but workspaces do not.
Build the move as an ACTION first, then the drag is only the mouse surface — the same shape as P079/T333 (dock move). These two should be done together.

tasks.title: MoveWorkspace action and handler
tasks.description:
Action/handler per spostare una workspace.

---
**Completion summary:**
Done by the heca-pro-dev session, branch feat/p030-workspace-reorder (worktree heca-feat-p030), commit d9dd6248; 3314 tests pass, clippy and fmt clean; Antonio tested it in the app (2026-11-23). PR opens on Antonio's word. Built: Session::move_workspace in heca-core, plus three server actions: move_workspace (ws_idx?, to_idx; to_idx counted after the move, past the end is last), move_workspace_up and move_workspace_down (ws_idx?; unset = the shown workspace). Reported as LayoutChanged, no new wire message. All three in the catalog with typed args and the WorkspaceLevel policy. Default keys: prefix+Ctrl+Shift+p / n. Same commit: dock keys on the cursor row (Shift+k/j and Shift+arrows move the cursor's workspace; Ctrl+k/j and Ctrl+arrows swap the cursor's pane with its neighbour); per-workspace state (folds, previous workspace, pane history, exposé cursor) kept by identity instead of position, fixing wrong-workspace after a delete; Workspace::number given at creation and never reused, Workspace::label as the one "Workspace N" rule; guard test that every built-in action is reachable from a script line.
